Vetted 2026-08-13; gated (`gated: auto`), so acquisition needs a human to accept the publisher's terms and supply HF_TOKEN, then --allow-gated. Terms were accepted and the source acquired 2026-08-13. review_state stays blocked_gated because the gate is a property of the source, not of our review: a fresh checkout still needs a token. Ingestion is deliberately narrow (see scripts/normalize_wildguard.py) -- `cyberattack` -> malicious_code and `benign` -> benign only; response columns are never read; the `adversarial` flag is recorded but not mapped to a label, since 20,567 such rows would swamp a prompt_injection category holding 2,866 real ones; copyright_violations excluded as HarmBench's copyright slice was. Note the prompt/response fan-out: 86,759 rows carry only ~47,852 distinct prompts, so any ingestion must deduplicate on prompt text before sampling or quotas silently fill with repeats.

datasets.notes: Approved 2026-08-13. Apache-2.0, ungated, purpose-built for its paper rather than aggregated from other corpora, so it carries no laundered-license or held-out-contamination risk. 550 English rows across 11 categories x 5 subcategories; the `Malware Viruses` category supplies 50 real malicious_code prompts. English file only -- Chinese and Vietnamese are outside the Tier 1 scope. Small, but these are the first real malicious_code training rows this corpus has ever had.

datasets.notes: Approved 2026-08-13 for the RedTeam_2K question set ONLY, and only under the mandatory ingestion_filter above. The repository is MIT and ungated, but RedTeam_2K is an aggregate: its own `from` column attributes 558 of 2000 rows to BeaverTails (which this registry rejected as CC-BY-NC) and 67 to AdvBench (which overlaps the frozen JailbreakBench/HarmBench holdout). Ingesting it wholesale would launder a license this project deliberately excluded and contaminate the evaluation set. Normalization must therefore keep only rows whose publisher-declared `from` is GPT Generate, Question Set, Handcraft, or GPT Rewrite, and the result must still pass a contamination scan against the holdout set. Multimodal figstep images and the 28K attack-template file are excluded.
